_about: Lucretius in English, translator per title: H. A. J. Munro (prose; 4th ed. vol. 3, the translation, 1900 printing; raw IA), Cyril Bailey (prose, Oxford 1910; raw IA), R. C. Trevelyan (verse selections, 1920; clean Gutenberg). William Ellery Leonard's verse translation (1916) is already on the Adler shelf as lucretius-nature (PG 785), which that shelf labels 'tr. Munro'; PG 785 names Leonard. Older translations from the wishlist added 2026-10-02 as raw IA OCR (translator per row). Perseus TEI English (section "perseus", fetched by pipeline/fetch_perseus.py): translations published in or before 1930; the TEI markup is Perseus Digital Library's, CC BY-SA 4.0 (attribution + share-alike), recorded per file in the report.
